name: Contour Lines
description: Rings traced like a survey map, alternating between ink colors, spacing held constant for the whole plate.

code.style: --rule: ( --gap: calc(6px + ${shapeFrequency} * 14px); background-color: var(--color0); background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, transparent 0, transparent calc(@var(--gap) - 1.4px), var(--color1) calc(@var(--gap) - 1.4px), var(--color1) @var(--gap), transparent @var(--gap), transparent calc(@var(--gap) * 2 - 1.4px), var(--color2) calc(@var(--gap) * 2 - 1.4px), var(--color2) calc(@var(--gap) * 2), transparent calc(@var(--gap) * 2), transparent calc(@var(--gap) * 3 - 1.4px), var(--color3) calc(@var(--gap) * 3 - 1.4px), var(--color3) calc(@var(--gap) * 3)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
